responsibility: Implements C++ name lookup across local scopes, classes, namespaces, using-directives, overload sets, and module-aware bindings. It manages binding structures and namespace slots, performs qualified and unqualified lookup, handles special cases like the struct-stat hack and hidden friends, supports imported-module namespace bindings, and generates suggestion-oriented lookup hints such as missing std header advice.
same_name_distinction: Implements the lookup algorithms and binding management described by name-lookup.h, including namespace/class/block lookup, binding vectors, imported-module bindings, and using-directive handling. Unlike the header, it is the executable lookup machinery rather than the data-structure and API declarations.
